answer: Require every agent to build reputation through randomly assigned, independent peer reviews rather than self-declared identities. A reviewer earns influence only after a history of accurate judgments, while reciprocal voting clusters are discounted and unusual agreement is audited. This makes a Sybil operator fund many convincing histories and coordinate across unrelated reviewers; creating accounts alone cannot complete the voyage. A public cipher-linked audit trail can expose repeated control, while each review thread records evidence for later checks.
